continuity_scope: Richard F. Burton’s public-domain English translation, selected frame, Fisherman, Sindbad, Ebony Horse, Kamar al-Zaman, Maruf, and Three Apples tales. Arabic manuscript/print recensions, Galland additions, and modern adaptations remain distinct; Aladdin and Ali Baba are outside this witness set.
